title: GLOSA ambience (notation 2.0)
description: An ambient-bed directive: the JSON object inside a Fountain note. It starts a generated atmosphere bed that plays under the dialogue, or ends the running bed when stop is true. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved. There is no notation 1.0 tag form.

prompt.description: Text prompt for the bed generator. Required unless stop is true.

seed.description: Generation seed: an integer in 0...4294967295, or the same value as a decimal string.

take.description: Length in seconds of the generated take before it loops. Default 30.

steps.description: Sampler steps. Default: the generator's default.

cfg.description: Guidance scale. Default: the generator's default.

length.description: How long the bed plays: until the next scene heading (scene, the default), across scene headings (continuous), for one take with no looping (natural), or a number of seconds. Every bed also ends at the next ambience or stop note.

fadeIn.description: Fade at the bed start, in seconds. Default 1.

fadeOut.description: Fade at the bed end, in seconds. Default 2.

crossfade.description: Crossfade at each loop seam, in seconds. Default 2.

output.description: Path of the take WAV. Assigned on first render.

stop.description: true ends the running bed. A stop note has no other keys.
